name: elfcaps
tagline: Static audit of Linux binaries: which privacy-sensitive X11, input and screen APIs they can reach
trendOrigin: Trend 1 (Zoom reads the X11 clipboard). xselaudit already catches clipboard reads while an app runs. This goes the other way: before you run a closed-source Linux app, find out what it is able to do. It was discovered by accident with Zoom, and it could have been found ahead of time.
